text:
Noah (Sales): Heads-up: CloudWave wants a 2-week Dedicated POC for a new model variant CloudWave-13B-q4v2. They provided HF link + tokenizer patch. Need catalog fit, secure onboarding, and a POC quote. Kickoff in 12 days.
Aisha (SE): Ask: target p95 latency and representative prompt set. Also whether they need customer KMS.
Noah (Sales): They want ~150ms p95 on short queries and customer-managed KMS. HF link: https://huggingface.co/cloudwave/cloudwave-13b-q4v2 (attached tokenizer_patch.zip).
Marco (MLOps): Quick plan: pull artifact, check safetensors/pt, inspect quant format, tokenizer tokens, kv/cache bytes/token, max_seq. Will run inspector and quick model-scan.
Rina (Product): For cataloging we need license, expected perf, conversion notes if quant is nonstandard, and recommended default rollout policy.
Oleg (Security): Security checklist: run trojan/backdoor scan, sanitize tokenizer in sandbox, provide SBOM, and confirm KMS+audit log capabilities. Also customer requests ephemeral model mounts.
Marco (MLOps): Pulled artifact: safetensors, quant=q4_k_m_custom, tokenizer has extra delimiters, max_seq=4096. Inspector output: "loaded; warning: attn_head_dim mismatch; kv_cost ~1.0MB/token". Running model-scan now.
Aisha (SE): That head_dim mismatch could require a conversion. If converter needed, impacts timeline and kernel selection. Need perf delta estimates for A100/H100.
Marco (MLOps): I'll attempt conversion script: run `scripts/convert_layout.py` in sandbox, then perf smoke. Will produce manifest with model_format, tokenizer_patch, kv_cache_shape, quant_profile, conversion_notes.
Oleg (Security): Tokenizer patch must be sanitized before mount. Use sandbox command: `docker run --rm rwi-sandbox python -m tokenizers.normalize tokenizer.json`. Third-party scan requested by customer will need extra lead time. We can offer a partner scan for a fee.
Noah (Sales): Pricing: they want flat POC fee + overage. Baseline load: 500 rps sustained for tests. Can we give infra estimate for 2-week POC with baseline 4 replicas and bursts to 24?
Marco (MLOps): Rough infra estimate: A100 fleet ~$6.5k, H100 fleet ~$10.5k for that config. Managed SRE & support ~3.5k. If conversion to q4_opt needed, extra engineering time ~2-3 engineer-days.
Rina (Product): Acceptance criteria: functional correctness, latency target met during scaled tests, and embedding similarity vs CloudWave-7B >= 0.9 on eval set. We'll run A/B and provide examples.
Aisha (SE): I'll prepare a POC runbook and fallback strategy to CloudWave-7B with an automated traffic-shift policy for failure scenarios.
ticket-bot: Ticket INF-5068 created: "CloudWave-13B-q4v2 POC onboarding" assigned to MLOps. Link: https://redwood/infra/tickets/INF-5068
Noah (Sales): Timeline: security answers & preliminary scan by Wed, compatibility + perf report by Fri, POC config & final quote next Tue. Can we commit?
Oleg (Security): Preliminary scan results by Wed okay. Partner scan needs 3 business days.
Marco (MLOps): Friday for perf + compat report is doable if conversion not required; will escalate if needed.
Noah (Sales): Thanks all 64f; I'll send the draft POC proposal tonight and flag any blockers.
